analogy.rationale: DAGLA/DAGLB are diacylglycerol lipases that synthesize 2-arachidonoylglycerol, an endocannabinoid; inhibiting them perturbs lipid signaling but the transcriptional consequences in these cell lines are likely modest and overlap most with other lipid-signaling modulators such as FAAH inhibitors.
